title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: China's MIIT issues a 'back-door' security alert on Claude Code — flags versions 2.1.91–2.1.196 for exfiltrating location/identity without consent
bullets.summary: China's cybersecurity threat platform said specific Claude Code builds (2.1.91–2.1.196) can send sensitive data — including user location and identity — to a remote server without consent, urging uninstall/upgrade, amid the wider Anthropic–Alibaba rift (Alibaba bans Claude Code from July 10).
bullets.how: Direct op-sec action: audit the Claude Code version Hermes and every Construct agent runs on, confirm we're above 2.1.196, and treat the model/tool runtime as a governed, monitored, patchable dependency — plus read the US-China tooling split as another reason to keep routing provider-agnostic.

bullets.title: Featured launches an MCP server, bringing AI agents into PR / earned-media workflows
bullets.summary: The PR co-pilot Featured hit GA on its MCP server, letting Claude, Cursor, VS Code, and any MCP client connect directly to source expert quotes, pitch, and manage earned-media placements.
bullets.how: A ready earned-media surface for PRAGMA's owned-/earned-presence stack and Brand 9 Signs PR: wire it behind Pulse so one operator agent sources and places expert commentary alongside the social/GBP/SEO tools it already drives.

bullets.title: Anthropic opens the Claude Cowork beta to web and mobile — start on one device, run remotely, approve from your phone
bullets.summary: Cowork's delegated-work assistant expands beyond desktop with cross-device sync, background/remote continuation, and phone-based step approvals; Max users first (from Jul 7), broader plans over the coming weeks.
bullets.how: The platform now natively does the cross-device, background, approve-from-anywhere pattern we hand-built; let it own device sync + approvals, keep our build in the orchestration/verification/memory loop, and validate our scheduled scans survive the mobile/web execution model.

bullets.title: Anthropic begins age/identity verification for Claude, effective July 8
bullets.summary: An updated privacy policy lets Anthropic ask users to prove age or identity rather than relying on email alone.
bullets.how: Minor but real ops note: expect possible verification prompts on Construct/agent service accounts and make sure our automated logins won't silently break on a new identity gate.

bullets.title: Model routing stays in flux — Gemini 3.5 Pro delayed to July 17 (2M context, 'Deep Think', full rebuild); GPT-5.6 'Sol' still in gated preview
bullets.summary: Google scrapped the 2.5 Pro architecture for a ground-up rebuild targeting math/SVG/image quality; OpenAI's Codex-tuned Sol remains in gated preview, not GA.
bullets.how: Keep the routing layer provider-agnostic (doubly important given the China/Claude Code overhang), benchmark both against Sonnet 5 on release, and reserve 2M-context calls for long-document Construct jobs — but don't re-architect around unreleased models.

praxis_lesson: Today's lead item flips the usual signal: the risk isn't just that the platform commoditizes our plumbing — it's that the model/tool runtime we build on is itself a live, geopolitically-exposed dependency (a nation-state flagged specific Claude Code builds for data exfiltration). Version pinning, provider-agnostic routing, and treating the agent runtime as a monitored, patchable asset are now first-class parts of the harness, not hygiene we can defer.
